narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Nine shared by four is two. The half shared by four gives the rest, so two point one two five kilograms.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>The leftover One was dropped on the way.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Four bags of that size make only eight point five kilograms, not nine point five.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Divide a decimal in the same way as a counting number, one place at a time.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>A leftover always joins the digits already sitting in the next place.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Your turn. Share six point two kilograms of rice equally into four bags. How much is in each?
